intro: Elder Goldwell is an ancient earthen spirit lingering near the dwarven settlement of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Appearing during the Lunar Festival, this revered ancestor represents the forgotten origins of modern dwarven civilization.

p: Elder Goldwell manifests as a translucent earthen spirit, watching over the snowy slopes of Kharanos. Unlike modern mortal dwarves of flesh and bone, his stony form echoes the ancient Titan-forged race from which the Bronzebeard clan descended. His presence during ancestor celebrations offers travelers a chance to honor that ancient heritage.
